clauses.title: Scope – Requirements of manufacture, dimensions
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirements of manufacture, dimensions and marking for fabricated PVC threaded adaptors for potable water supplies.

clauses.title: Requirements – The general
clauses.text: 2. Requirements - The general requirements for sizes, methods of test, sampling and critieria for conformity shall conform to  IS 10124 (Part 1) : 1988.

clauses.title: Marking
